results.title: Rising cyber threats: SEC moves to assess vulnerabilities across Nigeria’s capital market
results.description: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has begun a sector-wide cybersecurity assessment of Nigeria’s capital market operators as concerns over rising digital threats push regulators to strengthen the protection of financial systems. The commission directed capital market operators to submit their cybersecurity risk assessment reports on or before November 5, 2026, The post Rising cyber threats: SEC moves to assess vulnerabilities across Nigeria’s capital market appeared first on National Accord Newspaper.
